name: Technical Report Builder
description: Turn findings into a report that separates facts, observations, and conclusions.

permissionsRequired.reason: Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Read a source file that is already in the project.
Read the persisted document back as text.

validation.rule: The report artifactId was persisted and read back. Facts, observations, and conclusions are separate, and every citation comes from a tool result.
